purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
The WM-ORG-014 parent signal and every sibling edge remain provisional rather than canonical.
Signal, party, lead, customer, account and opportunity identities remain separate.
Qualification, score, stage, probability, forecast and outcome axes retain source, method, version, time and contestability qualifiers.
Estimated value remains distinct from price, quote, order, contract, recognized revenue and cash.
Privacy, direct-marketing, communication and profiling rules remain jurisdiction and purpose scoped.
The TMF699 release-label inconsistency remains explicit.
Every external mapping is version-pinned, profile-qualified and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The pursuit boundary is coherent and does not absorb neighboring identity, customer, campaign, catalog, activity, communication, commercial, fulfilment, finance or records masters.
Lead signal, known party, qualified lead, customer or account and opportunity are not treated as interchangeable.
Qualification, score, stage, probability, forecast category, expected close and actual outcome are not treated as mutually proving facts.
Value assertions distinguish amount type, currency, recurrence, range, basis and non-equivalence to price or commitment.
Conversions, merges, splits, corrections, holds, reopenings and closures preserve prior evidence and do not cascade into external masters.
Autonomous contact, consent creation, sensitive-attribute inference, adverse action, quote, order, contract, forecast commitment, disclosure and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
